title: hymenophyllum demissum
intro: Hymenophyllum demissum, commonly known as the "dwarf fern," is a species of fern in the family Hymenophyllaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Hymenophyllum demissum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that have been shown to possess antioxidant and antimicrobial properties. However, further research is needed to fully understand the medicinal properties and potential applications of this plant.
